requirements.statement: A Registry Officer can log physically received correspondence with an attached scanned copy

criteria.must: A Registry Officer can create a new correspondence item with sender, category, and a scanned document attachment
A logged physical item appears in the system immediately after being saved

requirements.statement: Incoming email correspondence is captured into the system automatically

criteria.must: An email received at a configured intake mailbox results in a new correspondence item logged automatically, without manual entry

requirements.statement: A Registry Officer reviews newly logged items and assigns each to the responsible department

criteria.must: A Registry Officer can view a list of newly logged, unrouted correspondence items
A Registry Officer can assign a newly logged item to a department
After assignment, the item shows the department it was routed to

requirements.statement: A Registry Officer can reassign a misrouted item to a different department

criteria.must: A Registry Officer can change the department assigned to an already-routed correspondence item

requirements.statement: A Department Officer can see all correspondence assigned to their department

criteria.must: A Department Officer can view a list of correspondence items currently assigned to their own department
A Department Officer does not see correspondence assigned to a different department in that list

requirements.statement: A Department Officer can update the status of a correspondence item as they work on it

criteria.must: A Department Officer can change the status of an item assigned to their department (e.g., to in progress)
The updated status is visible to other users viewing that item

requirements.statement: A Department Officer can record the response issued for a correspondence item, including an attached response document

criteria.must: A Department Officer can record a response note and/or an attached response document against a correspondence item
The recorded response is retrievable from that correspondence item afterward

requirements.statement: A Department Officer can close a correspondence item once it has been responded to, marking it resolved and removing it from the active queue

criteria.must: A Department Officer can close a correspondence item that has a recorded response
A closed item no longer appears in the active/open queue
An item with no recorded response cannot be closed

requirements.statement: A Supervisor can see a dashboard of all correspondence across departments with their current status

criteria.must: A Supervisor can view a dashboard listing correspondence items from every department
Each item on the dashboard shows its current status

requirements.statement: A Supervisor can see items that are overdue against their expected turnaround

criteria.must: An item past its due date is visibly flagged as overdue to the Supervisor
An item not yet past its due date is not flagged as overdue

requirements.statement: A Supervisor can reassign correspondence between departments or officers to rebalance or correct workload

criteria.must: A Supervisor can reassign a correspondence item to a different department

requirements.statement: A Registry Officer or Supervisor can search and filter correspondence by sender, department, status, or date

criteria.must: A Registry Officer or Supervisor can filter correspondence by sender
A Registry Officer or Supervisor can filter correspondence by department
A Registry Officer or Supervisor can filter correspondence by status
A Registry Officer or Supervisor can filter correspondence by date

requirements.statement: A Registry Officer, Department Officer, or Supervisor can see the full movement history of a correspondence item

criteria.must: A correspondence item's movement history lists who it was routed to and when
A correspondence item's movement history lists the actions taken on it

requirements.statement: A Department Officer is notified when a new item is assigned to them

criteria.must: A Department Officer receives a notification when a correspondence item is newly assigned to them

requirements.statement: An Admin can create, rename, and deactivate departments/units

criteria.must: An Admin can create a new department
An Admin can rename an existing department
An Admin can deactivate a department
A deactivated department is no longer available as a routing option for new or reassigned items

requirements.statement: An Admin can onboard a user into a department and assign them a role (Registry Officer, Department Officer, or Supervisor)

criteria.must: An Admin can assign a user to a department and one of the three roles
After onboarding, the user can access the correspondence relevant to their assigned role and department

requirements.statement: A Public Viewer can see a public dashboard of each department's SLA performance against its turnaround targets

criteria.must: The SLA performance dashboard is reachable without signing in
The dashboard shows SLA/turnaround performance broken down per department
The dashboard does not display individual correspondence content, sender details, or the status of a specific item

requirements.statement: An Admin can configure the mailbox that feeds email intake, either one organization-wide default or a separate mailbox per department

criteria.must: An Admin can configure an organization-wide default intake mailbox
An Admin can configure a separate intake mailbox for an individual department
Email received at a department's own configured mailbox is captured as correspondence for that department
